info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Current Account Management API
info.description: The Corporate Current Account Management API is designed to facilitate the management of corporate banking transactions, specifically for corporate current accounts. This API allows users to perform essential operations related to account deposits and lending, streamlining processes for businesses. Typical consumers include financial institutions, corporate clients, and accounting software providers looking to enhance their services. By leveraging this API, businesses can effectively manage their financial operations and improve transaction efficiency.

post.summary: Create a new corporate current account.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new corporate current account in the deposit lending system. It requires necessary account information and validates the input parameters to ensure compliance with our banking standards.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating a corporate current account under the deposit lending operation. This body must include all necessary details for establishing the account, such as the account holder's information and relevant financial data.
